newsitem.title: USA: Control Data Systems inks Intranet pact.
newsitem.headline: Control Data Systems inks Intranet pact.

text.p: Control Data Systems Inc said Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to provide its Intranet software to Global One, a joint venture between Deutsche Telekom AG, France Telecom and Sprint Corp.

The company said technology from its Rialto suite of Interanet software will become part of Global One's "Global Intranet" product. Global Intranet is designed to provide security, directory services, electronic messaging, access to databases and Web-based document retrieval, Control Data said.
Control Data is a software and services company.
Its shares closed down 1/4 Wednesday at 22-1/8.
